newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FIRST-ROUND DRAFT SELECTIONS.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FIRST-ROUND DRAFT SELECTIONS.

text.p: First-round selections at
the NFL draft on Saturday (team, player, position, college):
1. St. Louis (from New York Jets) -- Orlando Pace, offensive
tackle, Ohio State.
2. Oakland (from New Orleans) -- Darrell Russell, defensive
tackle, Southern Cal.
3. Seattle (from Atlanta) -- Shawn Springs, corner back,
Ohio State.
4. Baltimore -- Peter Boulware, defensive end, Florida State.
5. Detroit -- Bryant Westbrook, cornerback), Texas.
6. Seattle (from St. Louis via New York Jets and Tampa Bay)
-- Walter Jones, tackle, Florida State.
7. New York Giants -- Ike Hilliard, wide receiver, Florida.
8. New York Jets (from Tampa Bay) -- James Farrior, line
backer, Virginia.
9. Arizona -- Tom Knight, cornerback, Iowa.
10. New Orleans (from Oakland) -- Chris Naeole, guard,
Colorado.
11. Atlanta (from Chicago through Seattle) -- Michael Booker,
cornerback, Nebraska
12. Tampa Bay (from Seattle) -- Warrick Dunn, running back,
Florida State.
13. Kansas City (from Houston) -- Tony Gonzalez, tight end,
California.
14. Cincinnati -- Reinard Wilson, defensive end, Florida
State.
15. Miami -- Yatil Green, wide receiver, Miami-Florida.
16. Tampa Bay (from San Diego) -- Reidel Anthony, wide
receiver, Florida
17. Washington -- Kenard Lang, defensive end, Miami-Florida.
18. Houston (from Kansas City) -- Kenny Holmes, defensive
end, Miami-Florida.
19. Indianapolis -- Tarik Glenn, offensive tackle,
California.
20. Minnesota -- Dwayne Rudd, linebacker, Alabama.
21. Jacksonville -- Renaldo Wynn, defensive end, Notre Dame.
22. Dallas (from Philadelphia) -- David LaFleur, tight end,
LSU
23. Buffalo -- Antowain Smith, running back, Houston.
24. Pittsburgh -- Chad Scott, cornerback, Maryland.
25. Philadelphia (from Dallas) -- Jon Harris, defensive end,
Virginia.
26. San Francisco -- Jim Druckenmiller, quarterback, Virginia
Tech.
27. Carolina -- Rae Carruth, wide receiver, Colorado.
28. Denver -- Trevor Pryce, defensive end, Clemson.
29. New England -- Chris Canty, cornerback, Kansas State.
30. Green Bay -- Ross Verba, offensive tackle, Iowa.
